variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: First use: no response yet. A flush card explains what canned responses are and offers New response in place of the search and the table.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The first load: the search row and the table's loading rows, before the empty state can be decided.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: The list could not load: a danger Alert with Retry replaces the search and the table.

variants.name: NoMatch
variants.summary: Filters that match nothing (folder Billing and visibility Personal): the table shows No matching responses with Clear filters.

variants.name: Editing
variants.summary: The edit drawer open on Ask for the request ID: title, folder, visibility, the reply with Insert placeholder, and the status it sets.

variants.name: Saving
variants.summary: Save response in flight: the drawer's fields lock and the submit button spins; the drawer closes when the save ends without an error.

variants.name: SaveError
variants.summary: The save failed: a danger Alert at the top of the drawer says the previous version still applies, and every value stays as typed.
